title: Out of Office Beaches
meta_description: Out of Office Beaches: 5BR Seacrest Beach retreat with lagoon pool access, bunk room, bikes, game garage, and covered lanai---perfect for the family!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to your home away from home. We hope you don't have to work while you're here, but if you do, then this Out of Office Beaches, home will make you want to stay on 30A, permanently. This home is located in Seacrest Beach which is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A. This magnificent 5 bedroom, 5 1/2 bathroom home in Seacrest Beach, is the perfect place for a multi-generational family to enjoy all of 30A and Florida's Emerald Coast. Out of Office Beaches is a contemporary designed home with an open concept, state of the art kitchen and living room, and so much more. This is the place you'll make wonderful memories with family and friends and want to return year after year. Out of Office Beaches has all the ingredients needed for a fantastic family vacation.

On the main floor there is a half bath for guests and a King Master, including a luxurious ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower. Upstairs you'll find more room to relax in the bonus area where kids can watch the game or movie while parents hang out on the covered lanai. This outstanding outdoor entertainment area is the place to be after a fun day at the beach. Fire up the grill and grab your cocktails as you watch the sun descend into the sea. Down the hall is another King Master and two Queen rooms, all with private bathrooms. And, there's also a bunk room with two double bottom bunks and twins on top with the bathroom just across the hall.

ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water, just 2 blocks away. While the beach is just as amazing here as it is elsewhere on this stretch of shore, there are a number of characteristics that make this town unique and worth a visit. Bikes and flip-flops are the transportation of choice here. Seacrest Beach has a deeded beach accesses so visitors can easily access the beach from the neighborhood.

AMENITY ACCESS: In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.

\*\*\* Attention Guests, please note that there is an additional fee of $2 per day per guest staying at this property in Seacrest Beach. We are required by the Seacrest Beach HOA to collect this fee in order for you to stay in this community and use their amenities. We will collect this fee prior to your arrival.

BEACH ACCESS: Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 4 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 5 -- 2 Twin/Full Bunks
• 1 Queen Pull out Sofa

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Bikes
• Balconies with views on every floor
• Ping pong table, corn hole game, shuffleboard, arcade game in garage
• Smart TVs
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Coffee Maker -- Pod \& Traditional
• Full linen package
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces. Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
